MODAL.TITLE: Bulk AI Agent assignment
MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Apply an AI Agent to all contacts matching the current filter.
MODAL.EMAIL_SUBJECT_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. {contacto}, an idea to cut your shipping costs
MODAL.EMAIL_SUBJECT_HINT: It's the first thing the prospect sees. You can use {contacto} (first name) and {empresa}. Follow-up emails go out as “Re: …”.
MODAL.EMAIL_SUBJECT_B_PLACEHOLDER: Another way to say it, to compare
MODAL.EMAIL_SUBJECT_B_HINT: If you fill it in, half of the prospects get the subject above and the other half this one. The campaign detail shows which one gets more replies so you can keep the winner.
MODAL.SKIP_ACTIVE: Skip contacts that already have an active AI Agent
MODAL.CONTACTS_COUNT_PREFIX: Contacts that will receive the AI Agent:
MODAL.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The selection exceeds the limit of {max} contacts. Adjust the filter or exclude contacts before confirming.
MODAL.PICK_AGENT_HINT: Pick an AI Agent to see the audience breakdown.
MODAL.AUDIENCE_FROM_CONTACTS: Audience taken from the Contacts filter.
MODAL.AUDIENCE_SAVED_HINT: It uses the audience the campaign was saved with. Pick a segment or a label to change it.
MODAL.ERROR_GENERIC: An error occurred while assigning the AI Agent.
MODAL.RESULT_QUEUED_BODY: {count} contacts are being processed in the background. Progress will show up in the campaign detail.
MODAL.ENDS_BEFORE_START: The end must be after the start.
MODAL.ENDS_PASSED: The end has already passed: pick a future end date or leave it empty.
MODAL.START_PASSED: The start has already passed: when you start it, it begins right then.
MODAL.RESPECT_WORKING_HOURS: Only business days and within working hours
MODAL.ON_REPLY_HINT: The AI reads every reply for the funnel; here you decide what to do with what it read.
MODAL.ON_REPLY_NOT_INTERESTED: Stop writing if they say they are not interested
MODAL.ON_REPLY_WRONG_PERSON: Stop writing if they say they are not the right person (wrong number or email)
MODAL.ON_REPLY_NOT_NOW: If they say “not now”, one more message in 30 days
MODAL.PROSPECTING_DAILY_CAP_HINT: If there are more contacts, the rest go out on the following business days.

PREVIEW.TITLE: Review audience

REASON.NO_PHONE: Channel needs a phone number and the contact has none
REASON.NO_EMAIL: Channel needs an email and the contact has none
REASON.UNSUPPORTED_CHANNEL: This channel can't start the conversation
REASON.IN_TRACKING: Already has an active follow-up on this channel
REASON.INVALID_EMAIL: Email is malformed or its domain does not accept mail

PREVIEW.WILL_CREATE: {count} follow-ups will be created on confirm.
PREVIEW.TOO_MANY_BODY: The audience has {total} contacts, over the preview maximum. Narrow the filter to see the per-group breakdown and launch the campaign.
